items.title: Google's new VaultGemma model – Differential Privacy explained
items.author: AI Coffee Break with Letitia
items.raw_text:
LLMs often memorize what they see — even a single phone number or address can stick forever in their weights. Google’s new VaultGemma changes that: it’s the first open-weight LLM trained from scratch with differential privacy, meaning secrets seen seldomly during training leaves no trace. 👉 In this video, we explain Differential Privacy through the concrete example of VaultGemma — how it works, why it matters, and what it means for the future of trustworthy AI.
